metadata.title: Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome-based streams of an e-commerce warehouse on Picqer: capture orders -> pick, pack and ship -> returns; purchase and receive -> keep inventory true; multi-client fulfilment and invoicing; automation and hardware; onboarding and ecosystem.
metadata.flowModelNote: Each step names the bricks it depends on; personas are documented in customers.json JTBD steps.

streams.description: From an order in any webshop, marketplace, B2B portal, ERP or API call to an allocated, prioritised picklist in the right warehouse, with stock synced back to every channel.
outcomes: Urgent orders reach the floor first
